description: PI+ is the flagship dynamic regional economic model of REMI, giving year-by-year economic and demographic forecasts of how a policy or investment affects employment, industry output, value added and gross regional product, personal income, wages, population by age and cohort, and the labour force. Users define the change, region and assumptions, run the model against a baseline, and review direct, indirect and induced effects by industry and geography over the chosen horizon. It is produced by Regional Economic Models, Inc., with offices in Amherst, Massachusetts and Washington, D.C., which also offers the TranSight transport, Tax-PI fiscal and E3+ energy and environment models. Coverage is United States local, state and national geographies, and case studies include a state's nuclear fleet, advanced air mobility and semiconductor plants. It is available through commercial licensing and consulting, with demonstrations on request; no price is shown. Caveats: the model is proprietary and results depend on scenario inputs and REMI's calibration, and the pages read give no technical documentation. For simulation it projects how infrastructure investments, plant closures or disruptions change a regional economy over decades, supporting capacity planning and resilience appraisals. It is related to the IMPLAN record in this catalogue, a static input-output alternative.
